description: Source code for D3D11 AV1 video accelerator implementation, including classes for picture handling, buffer management, and decoder interaction within the media namespace.

classes.name: D3D11AV1Picture
classes.description: Represents an AV1 picture buffer in D3D11 context, manages timestamp updates and in-picture usage state.

classes.name: D3D11AV1Accelerator
classes.description: Handles AV1 decoding acceleration using D3D11, manages decoder buffers, submission, and output of pictures.

classes.name: D3D11AV1Accelerator::ScopedDecoderBuffer
classes.description: Manages a scoped D3D11 decoder buffer, handling acquisition, commit, and error reporting.

methods.name: CreateAV1Picture
methods.description: Creates a new D3D11AV1Picture instance with optional grain application.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a scoped decoder buffer of specified type.

methods.name: SubmitDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Submits picture parameters, slice control, and bitstream buffers to the decoder.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Begins decoding a picture, fills picture parameters, and ends the frame.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs the decoded picture via the client.

methods.name: SetVideoDecoder
methods.description: Sets the current video decoder instance.

methods.name: FillPicParams
methods.description: Fills the DXVA picture parameters structure based on frame and sequence headers.
